translations.remembered vs. present: the mother in the memory and the person in the room
translations.gratitude vs. guilt: thank you and I’m sorry in the same breath
translations.love vs. time: what the years do to love and what love does to years
translations.the mother vs. the woman: the role and the person beneath the role
translations.sacrifice vs. self: what was given up and what that cost
translations.held vs. let go: held back from the sea and almost letting go
